units: <cite ref="Ketubot 111b:15">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>מביא ע׳ אחת וכ׳</he> will bring in one stalk on a wagon or a ship … and will use its wood for cooking; <he>ואין לך כל ע׳ וע׳ שאין וכ׳</he> and there will not be a stalk yielding less than thirty kegs of wine.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 6:2:5">Y. Naz. VI, 55ᵃ</cite> bot.; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="P00946"><he>עֲנָבוֹת</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: [ramified plants,] standing corn, fruit on the tree, crop.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:3:9">Y. Snh. II, 20ᵇ</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 23:11">II Sam. XXIII, 11</cite>, a.

<cite ref="I Chronicles 11:13">I Chr. XI, 13</cite>) <he>עדשים היו אלא שהיתה ע׳ שלהן יפה כשל שעורין</he> it was a field of lentils, but their growth was as fine as that of barley; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 4:9">Ruth R. to II, 9</cite> (Par. 5 beg.) <he>עִנְּבוּתָן דּוֹמָה לשעורין</he> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="D00284"><he>דומין</he></cite>, corr. acc.); (Midr. Sam. ch. XX <he>שמלתם</he>, read: <cite ref="U00077"><he>שִׁבּוֹלְתָּם</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="U00077"><he>שִׁבּוֹלֶת</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 165:9">Yalk. Sam. 165</cite> <he>היו גבוהים כשעורים</he>).—

<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 1:2">Peah. I, 2</cite> <he>לפי רוב הע׳</he> (Var. in Maim.) according to the quantity of the standing crop; [ed. <he>העֲנָוָה</he>, Ms. M. <he>העֲנָיָה</he>]. Ib. VI, 7 <he>כאילו היא ע׳ של שעורים</he> Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. <cite ref="P00958"><he>ענוה</he></cite>, Ms. M. <cite ref="P00982"><he>עניה</he></cite>) as if it were a crop of barley; v. <cite ref="P00958"><he>עֲנָוָה</he> I</cite>.
